research_note: Selected for this session after checking primary source pages. Connections are editorial judgments, not speaker endorsements. Books, papers, and recordings were not reviewed in full; listing checks and access limits are noted below. Additions checked 2026-10-17; earlier entries retain their individual source dates.

resources.title: RustSec Advisory Database
resources.why: Find published crate advisories and understand the inputs used by dependency audit tools.

resources.title: Cargo Vet guide
resources.why: Learn how reviewed versions and audit records can support dependency policy.
resources.caveat: Review evidence and advisory checks cover different risks; neither proves a dependency harmless.

resources.title: Be alert: targeted attacks on prominent Rustaceans
resources.why: Connect account compromise and social engineering to the path malicious releases can take.

resources.title: Auditing Rust Crates Effectively
resources.why: Explore effect analysis that narrows the code requiring manual dependency review.
resources.caveat: Research preprint; metadata and abstract checked, with no independent validation of its evaluation.

resources.title: OSTIF audit catalog
resources.why: Find original audit reports and compare their dates and scope with the dependencies you want to assess.
resources.caveat: Catalog review only; audit findings apply to the stated scope and date. Index reviewed; linked works need separate review.

resources.title: rustls security advisories
resources.why: Use maintainers’ advisories as an example of tracing an affected dependency version to a specific report.
resources.caveat: Index reviewed; resolve a specific version against the individual advisory.
